description: This file defines the 'XMatrix' struct, which represents a 3x3 matrix for 2D affine transformations, including methods for matrix operations such as translation, scaling, rotation, shearing, and transformation of points and vectors. It also includes conversion methods to other matrix representations, parsing, and string formatting.

classes.name: XMatrix
classes.description: A struct that encapsulates a 3x3 affine transformation matrix for 2D graphics, supporting operations such as multiplication, inversion, transformation of points and vectors, and creation of specific transformation matrices (translation, rotation, scaling, skew).

methods.name: GetElements
methods.description: Returns an array of doubles representing the elements of the matrix.

methods.name: Transform
methods.description: Transforms a point or an array of points/vectors by this matrix.

methods.name: Invert
methods.description: Inverts the matrix if it is invertible.

methods.name: CreateRotationRadians
methods.description: Creates a rotation matrix for a given angle in radians, optionally around a specified center.

methods.name: CreateScaling
methods.description: Creates a scaling matrix, optionally around a specified center.

methods.name: CreateSkewRadians
methods.description: Creates a skew (shear) matrix for given skew angles.
